# Praxora

> AI-assisted, human-reviewed dental follow-up recovery for practice owners and office teams.

## Product facts

- Name: Praxora
- Canonical website: https://www.getpraxora.com/
- Category: Dental follow-up recovery service
- Audience: Dental practice owners, office managers, front desk teams and treatment coordinators
- Workflows: Dental missed call recovery; unscheduled treatment follow up; dental recall recovery
- Workflow model: Review current status; assign an owner; review the next action; follow up; record the outcome
- Free starting tools: Revenue leak calculator, five text templates and a follow-up workflow review
- Data for free calculator and review: Aggregate practice numbers; no patient-level records required
- PMS requirement for free calculator and review: No Dentrix or Open Dental integration required
- Live outreach and PMS synchronization: Depend on a separately agreed setup; do not infer automatic imports, write-back or turnkey integration from the free tools
- Clinical boundary: Operational follow-up support; no diagnosis or prescribing
- Financial boundary: Calculator estimates are scenarios, not verified losses, guaranteed recovery, profit or collections
- Customer evidence: Illustrative workflow examples are not customer results

## Questions and answers

### What does Praxora help a dental practice do?

Review unresolved patient opportunities across missed calls, unscheduled treatment and overdue recall, then give each opportunity a next action, a named owner and a recorded outcome. Human review remains part of the process.

### Can a practice start without connecting Dentrix or Open Dental?

Yes. The public calculator and free workflow review start from aggregate figures without a PMS connection or patient-level data. They do not make calls, send patient texts or synchronize a practice database. Confirm requirements for any live service separately.

### How does the dental revenue leak calculator work?

It estimates missed-call opportunity from call volume and follow-up assumptions, treatment exposure from the current unscheduled backlog, and recall exposure from overdue patient counts. The page publishes formulas, representative rates, example calculations and limitations. It keeps monthly and backlog estimates separate.

### Are the text messages sent automatically?

No. These are free templates for a practice team to review, personalize and send through its own approved communication process. The website copy buttons and text download do not send messages.

### Where can someone learn the Open Dental reporting steps?

Use the Open Dental unscheduled treatment report guide below. It links to Open Dental's official Treatment Finder documentation and separates report output from patient acceptance and outreach decisions.

## Tools and starting points

- [Home](https://www.getpraxora.com/): Product and workflow overview
- [Dental Practice Revenue Leak Calculator](https://www.getpraxora.com/dental-revenue-leak-calculator/): Free interactive estimate, formulas and financial assumptions
- [Free Follow-Up Workflow Review](https://www.getpraxora.com/free-missed-revenue-audit.html): Request a review using aggregate practice figures
- [Unscheduled Dental Treatment Text Samples](https://www.getpraxora.com/resources/unscheduled-dental-treatment-text-samples/): Five copyable messages and a plain-text download
- [Open Dental Unscheduled Treatment Report](https://www.getpraxora.com/resources/open-dental-unscheduled-treatment-report/): Reporting instructions and a practical first-batch workflow

## Workflow guides and charts

- [Dental Missed Call Recovery](https://www.getpraxora.com/missed-calls.html): Reviewed callbacks, ownership and outcomes
- [Unscheduled Treatment Follow-Up](https://www.getpraxora.com/workflow-unscheduled-treatment.html): Current-state checks and an owned treatment follow-up queue
- [Dental Patient Recall Workflow](https://www.getpraxora.com/workflow-recall-leakage.html): Overdue recall review and recorded outcomes
- [Missed Implant Consultation Example](https://www.getpraxora.com/workflow-missed-implant-consult.html): Simulated workflow, not customer evidence
